insurer: Royal Sundaram General Insurance Co. Limited

room_rent.note: If room rent exceeds limit, all other expenses (except medicines) are paid proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment applies to every admissible claim for all insured persons

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year, whichever lower. Modern treatments (robotic surgery etc.): up to 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Reducible via portability/migration credits from prior continuous coverage

specific_disease_waiting.note: 20 conditions at 24 months (cataract, hernia, hydrocele, etc.); 2 conditions at 36 months (joint replacement, age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis)

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded (Section 7.18)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment in recognised AYUSH hospitals covered up to sum insured

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expense cover in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; fixed cap per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, deep brain stimulation, oral chemo, stem cell therapy etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical consumables (gloves, diapers, etc.) explicitly excluded in Annexure-A List I

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded; territorial limit is India only

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years no look-back applies except for proven fraud

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium; 30 days for quarterly, half-yearly and yearly modes

free_look.note: Not applicable for policies with tenure less than 1 year or at renewal

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability with continuity of waiting period credits

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary & OPD, maternity, infertility/IVF, overseas treatment, refractive error <7.5D, war, nuclear/bio/chemical, substance abuse
